name: Moresi.com Data Center, Melano
notes: Company page describes a neutral data center in Melano, Ticino; Canton Ticino profile says Moresi designed and built a data centre from scratch in 2012 and co-owns BancaDati.ch in Manno.

name: Swiss National Supercomputing Centre CSCS, Lugano
notes: Official CSCS sources place the national supercomputing centre at Via Trevano 131 in Lugano; CSCS described construction of a roughly 2,000 sqm machine room and lists Alps compute/data infrastructure housed at CSCS in Lugano.

name: Swiss Data Safe, Amsteg
notes: Swiss Data Safe's official site describes high-security data center infrastructure embedded in Alpine rock at Gotthardstrasse 1, Amsteg, with redundant carriers, power, cooling, fire prevention, and access controls.

name: SH2 Data Centre, Gland
developer: Safe Host / STACK Infrastructure; Webuild and CSC Costruzioni as contractor
notes: Webuild lists SH2 in Gland, Canton of Vaud as engineering in progress and states construction adds 18 MW of capacity; CSC says the work includes 18 MW of IT capacity. Earlier DCD coverage described the broader SH2 buildout as a 40 MW facility.

name: BrainServe Datacenter, Crissier
notes: BrainServe describes itself as an independent Swiss company operating a Tier IV certified datacenter at Rue de la Vernie 12, Crissier; Vaud's investment agency lists Crissier and Renens among the canton data center locations.

name: AlpineDC Crissier Datacenter
notes: AlpineDC's Crissier site near Lausanne is presented as its primary site for colocation, housing, and IP connectivity; Vaud's investment agency lists Crissier as a data center location in the canton.

name: Leuk Teleport and Data Centre
developer: Leuk Teleport and Data Centre / Signalhorn AG
notes: Leuk's official blog describes the LEUK Data Centre in Valais as up to a 4 MW facility with 1,000 sqm available for customer expansion; Data Center Map lists the facility at Satellitenbodenstation Leuk Brentjong 2, Leuk-Stadt, and notes capacity for 1,000 racks with major expansion potential.

name: CKW Datacenter Zug, Rotkreuz
notes: DCD reported CKW Fiber Services opened DC Zug in Rotkreuz in January 2023; the 700 sqm facility was first announced in October 2021 and built next to the CKW Rotkreuz substation.

name: DATAWIRE Datacenters ZG01 and ZG02, Cham/Zug
notes: DATAWIRE states it operates two state-of-the-art data centers in Canton Zug, with ZG01 and ZG02 pages describing redundant cooling, UPS, power feeds, monitoring, and security controls.

name: Green Metro-Campus Zurich, Dielsdorf buildings N and O
notes: DCD reported Green began construction on Dielsdorf buildings N and O in October 2023, adding a combined 35 MW and about 4,000 racks; Green's own location page describes Campus ZRH2 in Dielsdorf as a three-data-center hyperscale campus.

name: Vantage Zurich II, Glattfelden
notes: Switzerland Global Enterprise reported Vantage's second Swiss hyperscale data center in Glattfelden, Canton Zurich, would provide 24 MW across 21,000 sqm and was set to commence operations in summer 2025.

name: Vantage Zurich I Campus, Winterthur
notes: S-GE states Vantage Zurich 1 in Winterthur commenced operations in December 2021 and that the flagship campus was announced as three data centers totaling 40 MW of critical IT load over 3.7 hectares.

name: STACK Zurich campuses ZUR01, ZUR02, ZUR03
notes: STACK's official Zurich page lists ZUR01, ZUR02, and ZUR03 campuses serving hyperscale and cloud demand; Baxtel lists ZUR03 at Murzlenstrasse as planned with year planned 2029. Note: some Zurich-market assets may sit outside Canton Zurich, so location should be refined before site-specific use.

name: Digital Realty Zurich data centers ZUR1, ZUR2, ZUR3
notes: Digital Realty's Zurich metro page lists three Glattbrugg data centers totaling 270,300 sq ft / 25,100 sqm of colocation space, with addresses at Saegereistrasse 35 and Baeulerwisenstrasse 4/6 in CH-8152 Glattbrugg.
